description: Graceful-degradation fixture: a supermarket receipt, not a lab report. Chosen as a HARD negative rather than an easy one. It is structurally very close to a lab report -- a business header, a reference number, a date, a column header row, and eight lines of 'label + number' that a naive row matcher would happily accept as test results. What it lacks is any clinical unit (mg/dL, g/dl, %) and any reference-range column. The service must return a structured not_a_lab_report error, not a report listing 'Basmati Rice 5kg' with a value of 720.00.

lines.text: Thank you for shopping with us
